answer: The ledge assignment is published and lantern records each panel. The grading quorum of 6 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an adversary cannot sit on the panel that judges it. Shards are assigned from the quill graph, so that cluster membership directly reduces grading power. A farm of 4608 identities would post 2026 proofs and burn roughly 52 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
